Hi Claire / Amit,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — really appreciate you walking through Acme's inference needs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap:
- Current infra: mix of AWS services, strict VPC peering requirements, and an internal compliance checklist (SOC2 + data residency notes).
- Pain: unpredictable latency at peak, concerns about sending sensitive telemetry to public endpoints, and a need for clearer cost predictability.
- What we demoed: Redwood hosted API for quick test, Dedicated pools for predictable throughput, and our Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) for complete network isolation.

Why Private (VPC/on-prem) may fit:
- Keeps traffic inside Acme's network and supports your compliance controls (can integrate with KMS/HSM).
- Predictable latency and capacity planning for batch and real-time workloads.

Proposed next steps:

Hi Claire - great to hear there's interest and totally understand needing ballparks to move this up the stack. Looping in Dev (cc) for the technical checklist and timeline; I included a very short high-level commercial range below so you have something to share internally.

Quick commercial ballpark (pilot, 1-2 nodes, 50-100M tokens/month):
- Entrypoint private (reserved pilot): $40k- $70k USD / month (includes reserved capacity and basic SLA).
- Full production private (larger capacity + 24/7 support): typically $90k+ / month depending on throughput, retention and optional on-prem services.

Estimated onboarding timeline:
- Kick-off & NDA: 1 week
- Network/IT review & approvals: 2-4 weeks (varies by enterprise)
- Provisioning & smoke tests: 1 week
- Pilot run & validation: 2-4 weeks
Total: ~6-10 weeks to pilot (typical).

Technical prerequisites (high level):
- VPC peering or private link + static egress IPs (we can work through options)
- Firewall rules to allow outbound to the provisioning endpoints (I'll have Dev send exact ports/ips)
- Optional on-prem deployment requires an air-gapped install package and access to the local orchestration layer

Attachments: deploy-checklist.csv (short checklist); also linking the VPC brief for reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-acme-vpc

Next steps:
1) Dev to share exact network/IP checklist and a short runbook (Dev, can you send this tomorrow?)
2) If the numbers look OK, I'll prepare a scoped SOW and internal estimate for procurement.

Thanks and happy to jump on a call if that's faster.
